name: Albertslund Lille Skole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child 15%, 3rd child 40%, 4th child (and beyond) 70%; discount applied to the youngest child's school/SFO fee
profile: A 'lilleskole' (small alternative free school) in Albertslund with project-based, nature-integrated learning ('the school between the trees'), one class per grade, and a strong community focus.
curriculum: Danish (independent free school, own curriculum within Danish legal requirements)
waitlist: Rolling admission when space is available; families can join a waiting list any time by contacting the office; tours for 0. klasse begin in autumn of the preceding year.
notes: Fee tiers for 2025-2026: SFO (0.-3.) 1,097 kr/month; 0.-3. klasse 1,994 kr/month; 4.-9. klasse 2,327 kr/month. Fees typically rise each Aug 1 in line with state subsidy/wage changes. Need-based fee reduction ('fripladstilskud') available for low-income households. No explicit statement of months-billed-per-year or an enrollment fee was found.

name: Esajasskolen
siblingDiscount: Grades 0-3: 1,690 kr (1st child)/1,250 kr (2nd)/860 kr (3rd+). Grades 4-9: 1,960 kr (1st)/1,490 kr (2nd)/1,115 kr (3rd+). SFO full-time: 1,595 kr (1st)/1,145 kr (2nd).
profile: Christian independent school ('kristen friskole') in Hvidovre focused on presence/small classes (max 22 pupils), academic quality, and inclusion, grounded in Christian values.
waitlist: Waiting list managed via ventelisten.net (institution 167013) or by contacting the office directly.
notes: Page states fees apply to 'the current school year from 1 August' and are index-regulated each Aug 1 (rounded to nearest 10 kr); the exact calendar-year label wasn't visible in the fetched text, so feeYear is left null (fetched Sept 2026, likely 2026/27 in practice). Billing is 11 months/year — July is fee-free. Enrollment fee (500 kr) goes to a student support fund. SFO part-time (under 12 hrs) rate 1,195 kr; when two siblings both attend full-time SFO, one full-time + one part-time rate applies. Pre-school SFO charged at full-time rate with no sibling discount. Class fund max 250 kr/year; laptop required from grade 5; camp/trip fees ~250 kr baseline.

name: Taastrup Realskole
siblingDiscount: 1st child 1,840 kr, 2nd child 1,840 kr, 3rd child 920 kr (50%), 4th child (and beyond) free. Sibling discount only for biological/cohabiting siblings; not available on the pre-school (førskole) rate.
profile: Traditional Christian-founded 'realskole'/friskole in Taastrup, established 'in Christian, Danish spirit', with morning hymn-singing, the Lord's Prayer, Christmas services and mandatory religion class, combined with a strong academic ('realskole') focus and project-based work at higher grades.
waitlist: One-time waiting-list fee ('ventelistegebyr') of 450 kr; contact school directly regarding openings; ~732 pupils across 3 tracks per grade (4 tracks in grades 7 and 9 from 2026/27).
notes: Fee is a flat monthly rate per family position (1st/2nd/3rd/4th child), not tiered by grade — same 1,840 kr/month applies across all grades. SFO billed 12 months/year at 1,952 kr (1st child)/976 kr (2nd)/780 kr (3rd), morning-opening included. Pre-school (førskole) April-June rate 3,792 kr/month, July 1,952 kr. Enrollment/admin fee at registration: 1,050 kr/child + optional FI-card fee. Late-payment fees 50-100 kr. Class fund 2-300 kr/year; partial self-payment for camp/school trips.

name: Skt. Pauls Skole
siblingDiscount: School fee: 2nd child 1,700 kr, 3rd child 1,550 kr, 4th+ child free. SFO ('Solstrålen'): 2nd child 1,530 kr, 3rd+ child free. Sibling discount on the one-time enrollment fee was removed starting school year 2025/2026 (now flat 3,510 kr per child).
profile: Catholic primary school in Taastrup, operating under the Ansgar Foundation/Diocese of Copenhagen, combining Catholic values-based education ('think also of others' welfare') with a strong academic focus — the school reports the best 9th-grade exam results in the municipality.
gradesOffered: 0-9 (kindergarten class through 9th grade; full range inferred from references to 9th-grade exams and Catholic-school norms, not an explicit grade-list statement)
waitlist: Waiting list managed via ventelisten.net.
notes: Payment is monthly over 12 months via Nets; an administrative fee of 250 kr/month applies if automatic payment fails. One month's notice (to the 1st of a month) required for mid-year withdrawal. Half-month SFO fee applies if enrolling during summer break.

name: Vestegnens Privatskole
siblingDiscount: 300 kr/month reduction per additional sibling on the school fee; no sibling discount on the SFO fee.
profile: Private primary school in Taastrup emphasizing wellbeing, academics and character development ('dannelse'); certified UNICEF 'Rettighedsskole' (Rights Respecting School) teaching children's rights and democratic citizenship through daily practice and themed project weeks.
waitlist: Waiting list via ventelisten.net (institution 169018).
notes: School fee was 1,600 kr/month in 2024/25, rising to 1,700 kr/month for 2025/26 (12 monthly installments). SFO is 1,450 kr/month for Aug 2025-Jul 2026, rising to 1,550 kr/month from Aug 2026. Besides the 600 kr enrollment fee, a refundable 2,000 kr deposit and a 500 kr administration fee also apply. Children born in April who start pre-school pay 1,700 kr/month for 4 months (April-July) before formal school start. ~305 pupils, average 21.7 pupils/class.

name: Billums Privatskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child 20%, 3rd child 40%, 4th child 70% reduction, applied to school and SFO fees (not to the pre-school rate or one-time fees).
profile: Private school in Kgs. Lyngby (Lyngby-Taarbæk) emphasizing wellbeing and high academic standards ('trivsel og høj faglighed'), character development ('dannelse'), community, and a mobile-free learning environment; small classes (max 22, one class per grade) including a dedicated 'Superstarter' 0th-grade program.
waitlist: Admission via waiting list with MitID login; interviews for all applicants; a 14-day mutual trial period for grades 1-9; site notes 'currently limited openings' for the Superstarter (0th grade) intake.
notes: School fee 1,880 kr/month over 12 months is a flat rate (no grade-based tiering found). Fee page itself wasn't explicitly dated in the fetched text (a linked supervision report referenced 2024-2025), so feeYear is left null rather than guessed; fetched Sept 2026, so figures are presented as currently published. Pre-school (førskole) rate 2,600 kr/month for 2 months. 'Superstarter' meal program 350 kr/month over 11 months. Camp/school-trip fees roughly equivalent to 1-4 months' tuition depending on grade. Laptop/software required from grade 4. Class fund 300 kr/year.

name: Lyngby Private Skole
siblingDiscount: Sibling discount applies equally across all grades (exact %/amount not published on current page); a prior-year (2025/26) example showed 2nd child 1,915 kr/month, 3rd child 1,785 kr/month, 4th child 1,785 kr/month (grades 0-8, 12 months).
profile: General private grundskole with a focus on academic excellence, safety and care ('Faglighed, Tryghed, Omsorg'); mainstream Danish pedagogy, no specific religious or alternative-pedagogy affiliation.
notes: Grades 0-8: 2,100 kr/month over 12 months. Grades 9-10: 2,286 kr/month over 11 months (July free). SFO grades 0-5: 1,210 kr/month (12 months); club for grades 6-7: 500 kr/month (11 months); pre-SFO for incoming pupils: 1,945 kr each in May, June, July. Fees stated as non-refundable.

name: Skt. Knud Lavard Skole
siblingDiscount: Classes 0.-6.: 2nd child 1,075 kr/month, 3rd child 630 kr/month. Classes 7.-9.: 2nd child 1,200 kr/month, 3rd child 800 kr/month. SFO also has sibling reductions (2nd child 700 kr/month full-time).
profile: Catholic private school — one of Denmark's 22 Catholic private schools — single-track (one class per grade), located in Kongens Lyngby; follows the national curriculum with added Catholic religious education.
curriculum: Danish (Fælles Mål) with Catholic religious education
notes: Fees billed over 12 months/year. Classes 0.-6.: 1,500 kr/month (1st child). Classes 7.-9.: 1,600 kr/month (1st child). One-time enrollment fee (indmeldelsesgebyr) of 1,000 kr covers siblings enrolling later too. SFO 'Solsikken' billed over 11 months (900 kr/month 1st child full-time, plus a supplement for July hours; 700 kr/month for a 10-hrs/week option). The main domain www.sanktknudlavard.dk 307-redirects to sanktknudlavardskole.dk. No explicit school year was stated for the amounts found; treat as current pricing as of research date (Sept 2026).

name: Lyngby Friskole
siblingDiscount: Roughly 15% reduction for 2nd/3rd/4th child (e.g., 2nd child ~1,572 kr/month in the 0.-3. klasse tier); similar reduction pattern applies to SFO.
profile: Danish friskole (independent free school) in the national free-school tradition; follows the same 'Fælles Mål' objectives and exit exams as public schools, with an added Cambridge English program; emphasizes community, care and cross-age relationships.
curriculum: Danish (Fælles Mål) with Cambridge English certification track
notes: LOWER CONFIDENCE: the fee table on this page is rendered client-side and was not present in the raw page source when fetched directly (confirmed via curl); the figures here come from a search-engine synopsis of the same page and could not be independently re-verified — recommend confirming directly with the school. Reported figures: 0.-3. klasse tier 1,850 kr/month (1st child), other grade levels ('øvrige klassetrin') 1,790 kr/month; SFO (0.-3. klasse) 790 kr/month (1st child); a special 2,295 kr/month rate applies to pupils starting mid-year ('1. maj' intake), with July free for them. The school's own text confirms billing is 12 equal monthly instalments August-July, plus a 200 kr/month admin surcharge if not paying via Betalingsservice, and a refundable deposit (depositum, amount not found). No explicit Grundtvig-Kold affiliation was found despite the 'friskole' name.

name: Frederiksberg Privatskole
profile: Private 'overbygningsskole' (upper-grades-only school) founded in 1943, originally in Frederiksberg, relocated to Rødovre in 1998; enrolls ONLY grades 7-9 (~220 students, 17 teachers) — it is not a full 0-9/0-10 primary+secondary school.
waitlist: Active waiting list via an external system (ventelisten.net); one-time 500 kr waitlist registration fee; siblings get priority; admission interviews held each autumn before new 7th-grade classes start; occasional mid-year admission to existing classes if space opens.
notes: IMPORTANT: This school only takes pupils from 7th grade onward — there is no 1st grade, 0. klasse, indskoling or mellemtrin here, so the '1st grade' fee requested does not strictly apply. The monthlyFeeDKK shown (1,780 kr/month, paid over 12 months/year, confirmed structurally on the school's own site) is for its lowest offered grade (7th); the exact kr. amount itself was not found explicitly stated on frb-privatskole.dk (which only describes payment timing/structure) and instead comes from a third-party school-fee comparison article (frederiksbergliv.dk) that could not be fully re-verified (paywalled/JS-rendered) — treat with moderate confidence. Since only grades 7-9 exist, there is no SFO (after-school care is for younger children).

name: Nærum Privatskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd and 3rd child: 1,014 kr/month (roughly 50% reduction); 4th child free. SFO sibling discount: 800 kr/month for 2nd/3rd child.
profile: General small private school branded 'Det trygge valg' (the safe choice), emphasizing small classes, individual attention, stable/experienced staff, and nature-integrated learning; spans indskoling through udskoling.
waitlist: High demand — school states 'der er rift om pladserne på vores lille skole' (strong competition for spots); prospective families are advised to call immediately to join the waiting list for popular year groups.
notes: 1st child 2,028 kr/month, 2nd/3rd child 1,014 kr/month, 4th child free — all over 12 months. SFO (grades 0.-3.), full-time incl. summer weeks 27/31/32: 1,600 kr/month over 11 months; part-time (max 10 hrs/week): 1,280 kr/month over 11 months. A modest state subsidy is available to reduce fees/SFO payments for families with financial need. Confirmed starting grade is 0. klasse (kindergarten class); exact top grade (9th vs 10th) not fully confirmed but 9th grade Cambridge English program was referenced, implying 9 is the terminal grade.

name: Rudersdal Lilleskole
profile: A 'lilleskole' — a small, independent school within Denmark's alternative/lilleskole pedagogical tradition — emphasizing presence, engagement and community across all grade levels.
curriculum: Danish (national Fælles Mål, delivered within lilleskole pedagogy)
waitlist: Active external waiting list system; one-time non-refundable 500 kr waiting-list signup fee. A separate structured 'majbørn 2026' admission round (for children born around May) is mentioned, suggesting a competitive, structured intake process.
notes: School fee 2,270 kr/month and SFO 935 kr/month confirmed; billing frequency (11 vs 12 months/year) is NOT stated on the page, hence feeMonthsPerYear is null. A one-time refundable deposit/indskud of 6,810 kr is due at enrollment, repaid after the pupil finishes schooling provided fees are settled and books/materials returned (separate from the 500 kr non-refundable waitlist fee). Withdrawal notice period: current month + 3 months. Pupils are automatically unenrolled after 9th grade, confirming 9 as the top grade; starting grade referenced as børnehaveklasse (0.).

name: Ådalens Privatskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 150 kr/month reduction; 3rd child: 300 kr/month; 4th child: 450 kr/month (per-child reductions off the base fee).
feeYear: 2025 (rates stated as effective from 1 January 2025; still shown as current on site in Sept 2026)
profile: Mainstream Danish private school (0.-9. klasse) in Ishøj emphasizing problem-based learning (PBL) weeks, pupil democracy via student councils, and 1:1 IT devices; not affiliated with any religious or classic alternative-pedagogy movement.
waitlist: Online waitlist registration ('venteliste-tilmelding') exists but no published capacity/wait-time; new pupils get a 14-day trial period before enrollment is finalized; class composition for børnehaveklasse finalized after week 42.
notes: Listed institution website (skoleintra.dk) is a login-only intranet, not publicly fetchable (403/redirect loop). Actual public site is aadalprivat.dk (address: Skovvej 15-19, 2635 Ishøj). Flat monthly fee of 1,825 kr applies to ALL grades (no tiering by grade). SFO fee tiers: 1,430 kr/month through 31 May (up to 3rd-grade transition), then a 'Klub' rate of 970 kr/month from 1 June through 5th grade — treat sfoMonthlyDKK as the standard/lower-grade SFO rate. Enrollment costs break down as: 500 kr one-time non-refundable registration fee + 1,000 kr non-refundable enrollment fee + 2,200 kr refundable enrollment deposit; enrollmentFeeDKK above (1,500) sums only the two non-refundable pieces — the 2,200 kr deposit is refunded on withdrawal. Also a separate 'preschool' (bhkl. pre-start?) rate of 2,300 kr/month was mentioned but context unclear.

name: Amager Privatskole
siblingDiscount: 450 kr/month reduction for younger siblings, grades 0-9; SFO sibling rate is 1,120 kr/month (vs. standard 1,570 kr/month).
profile: One-track-per-grade private school in Kastrup/Tårnby (~239 pupils) describing itself as 'a village school in the big city'; a mainstream Danish privatskole with no specific alternative pedagogy or religious affiliation, focused on community, academic standards, character development and mandatory field-school (lejrskole) trips every year 0-9.
waitlist: Admission runs through the external platform ventelisten.net (institution no. 185013); a 500 kr fee is required to be placed on the waiting list, and the child is only registered once payment clears.
notes: Fee tiers by grade (2026, monthly): 0.-3. klasse 1,940 kr; 4. klasse 2,140 kr; 5.-8. klasse 2,320 kr; 9. klasse 1,880 kr (monthlyFeeDKK above uses the 0.-3. class/1st-grade tier). Number of annual billing installments (11 vs 12) is not stated on the site. Enrollment fee is defined as 'two months' school fees' (2 x 1,940 kr = 3,880 kr using the 1st-grade rate); pupils entering after kindergarten pay an extra 2,900 kr toward camp/lejrskole costs. SFO spring-term (May-June) full-day rate is higher at 3,880 kr/month. No specific pedagogical/religious profile description (e.g., Grundtvigian) was found on the site despite checking the 'profil', 'skolefakta' and homepage pages.

name: Gideonskolen
profile: A Christian (evangelical/free-church, 'apostolic Christian doctrine') independent school in Vallensbæk Strand, grades 0.-9., integrating daily Bible readings/devotions and Christian values into a standard Danish curriculum.
waitlist: School publishes a formal admission procedure page ('optagelsesprocedure') but no stated waitlist length, capacity, or published fees; interested families are directed to contact the office (43 57 01 40 / mail@gideonskolen.dk).
notes: No fee information (skolepenge, SFO, enrollment, sibling discount) could be found anywhere on gideonskolen.dk despite checking the homepage, 'optagelsesprocedure', 'skolens-aktuelle-vaerdigrundlag-og-paedagogiske-udgangspunkt', 'formaal-maalsaetninger', and a full crawl of the site's WordPress XML sitemap (~180 URLs, none referencing pricing/betaling/SFO). This appears to be a school that does not publish fees online; direct inquiry is required. School does not appear closed — site is active and well-maintained with current admissions content.

name: Birkerød Privatskole
siblingDiscount: 150 kr/month reduction for a first sibling; 450 kr/month reduction for additional siblings. Does not apply to SFO/Klub fees or the annual book fee (bogpenge).
profile: A well-established, mainstream private school in Birkerød (Rudersdal) covering grades 0.-9. with SFO ('Mini SFO'/SFO) and an older-pupil club ('Klub Bøgen'); runs as a classic Danish privatskole, member of Danmarks Privatskoleforening, without a distinct alternative-pedagogy or religious profile.
waitlist: Publishes a dedicated 'Ledige pladser' (available places) page and a separate 'Friplads' (need-based free-place/scholarship) page; 400 kr fee to be placed on the waiting list.
notes: Fees billed in 11 monthly installments/year. Tiers: grades 0.-5. = 2,000 kr/month; grades 6.-9. = 2,070 kr/month (monthlyFeeDKK above uses the 0.-5. / 1st-grade tier). SFO/Klub is also billed in 11 installments at 1,450 kr/month. Separate annual book fee (bogpenge) due 1 July: 2,000 kr (grades 0-5) / 2,070 kr (grades 6-9) — not included in the monthly figures above. Detailed vision/values pages exist but returned 404/could not be retrieved, so a deeper pedagogy description beyond 'classic mainstream privatskole' was not confirmed from source text.

name: Marie Kruses Skole
siblingDiscount: 1st & 2nd child pay full fee; 3rd child gets 33% discount; 4th+ child attends free. SFO ('Kometen'): 2 siblings in SFO get a 400 kr/month reduction; 3rd sibling in SFO is free.
profile: A long-established, academically ambitious private school in Furesø offering grundskole (0.-9. klasse), a 10th-grade year, and its own upper-secondary gymnasium (Kruses Gymnasium); emphasizes tradition, community ('fællesskab') and high academic ambitions rather than a distinct alternative pedagogy.
waitlist: No specific waitlist length/capacity information found on the site (a 'Grundskole' navigation section exists but detailed admission/queue info was not retrievable in this research pass).
notes: Flat fee applies across all grundskole grades (no grade tiering found), billed 12 months/year. School year 2025/26 rate was 2,285 kr/month, rising to 2,385 kr/month for 2026/27 (figure used above). SFO ('Kometen', for 0.-3. klasse) fee of 2,207 kr/month is effective from 1 January 2026. Enrollment/'startgebyr' equals one month's school fee (non-refundable if the child withdraws before starting) — used the 2026/27 rate (2,385 kr) above. General pedagogy/profile page content could not be retrieved (site repeatedly returned only cookie-consent text); description above is inferred from homepage tagline and grundskole section structure.

name: Rungsted Private Realskole
siblingDiscount: Built into the fee scale itself: 1st child 2,230 kr/month; 2nd child 2,110 kr/month; 3rd child 1,910 kr/month; 4th child and beyond attend free.
profile: A classic Danish 'realskole' in Hørsholm spanning a pre-school year (Miniforskolen) through 9th grade, organized into Indskoling (0.-3.), Mellemskole (4.-6.) and Udskoling (7.-9.); a mobile-free campus with emphasis on academic depth, curiosity and wellbeing.
waitlist: Register via 'Skriv dit barn op' online form; as of this research, Miniforskolen intake for 2027 (children born 2021) had 'få ledige pladser' (a few spots left).
notes: Fees paid in 11 monthly installments in advance, roughly Aug-June (annual totals: 1st child 24,530 kr; 2nd child 23,210 kr; 3rd child 21,010 kr). Separate from the monthly fee, there is a refundable enrollment/security deposit of 6,000 kr per child (returned on departure) plus the 450 kr one-time registration/transfer fee (enrollmentFeeDKK above is the non-refundable 450 kr; the 6,000 kr deposit is refundable and noted here rather than in that field). SFO ('Ønskeøen') fee of 1,733 kr/month applies to børnehaveklasse through 3rd grade. Main domain (rpr-skole.dk without 'www') worked; the 'www.' variant given in the brief returned connection errors.

name: Hørsholm Lille Skole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 2,160 kr/month (school fee), 3rd+ child: 200 kr/month; SFO Snøvsen 2nd child 1,150 kr/month, 3rd+ free
profile: A 'lilleskole' (small independent school) in Hørsholm run on an explicit pedagogical/value foundation emphasising community and individual learning; not religious or denominational.
waitlist: Registration open from birth via ventelisten.net (venteliste code 223007); school contacts families roughly two years before start; ~22 candidates invited to interview/selection process for BH-klasse; mid-year admission possible via trial days if space allows.
notes: Fee paid all 12 months including 9th grade. One-time indmeldelsesgebyr = 2,440 kr (1 month's fee); separate refundable deposit (indskud) = 4,880 kr (2 months' fee). SFO paid 11 months (July free). A separate after-school club 'Fritidsklub Basen' also exists (1,030/790/free kr per month, 11 months). Tuition covers normal school trips; larger trips (Berlin in 8th grade, international trip in 9th) cost extra (~5,000 kr). Partial fee subsidies (fripladstilskud) may be available depending on state funding pool.

name: Nordsjællands Grundskole og Gymnasium samt HF
siblingDiscount: 10% off for 2nd child, 20% off for 3rd child, 30% off for 4th+ child
profile: One of Denmark's largest private institutions, spanning grundskole, a 3-year and 5-year STX gymnasium track, and HF, built around the motto 'vilje, viden, værdier' (will, knowledge, values). Also operates an International Department (North Zealand International School, NIS) offering an IB track with its own fee schedule.
curriculum: Danish national curriculum (grundskole/gymnasium/HF); separate International Department offers IB in English
gradesOffered: 0-9/10 grundskole, plus 3-year and 5-year STX gymnasium and HF
waitlist: Not detailed on the fee page; applications handled via ngg.dk/om-ngg/praktisk-information/ansoeg.
notes: Fees listed as effective from 1 August 2026, indexed annually per Danmarks Statistik. SFO fee (2,000 kr/month) billed 11 months, with extra charges for holiday care. Income-based subsidy (friplads) can cover up to 27% of a max 20,400 kr/year, but the only concrete example on the page cites 2024/25 figures — may not yet be updated for 2026/27. The International Department (NIS) has separate published pricing (figures of 3,380 kr/month and 1,715 kr/month appeared associated with NIS/IB on ngg.dk/nis/info/school-fees) — check that page directly if evaluating the international track rather than the Danish track priced above.

name: Høje Taastrup Privatskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,150 kr/month, 3rd child: 800 kr/month, 4th child: free (school fee tiers)
profile: General-purpose independent school (privatskole) in Høje-Taastrup, founded 2013, with a modern, non-denominational pedagogical profile centred on safety, engagement and community ('#bedrefremtid').
waitlist: Online waitlist registration requires MitID/parents' CPR numbers. As of Dec 2025 snapshot: open spots in 0.(2), 1.(10), 2.(6), 3.(8), 4.(6), 5.(10) klasse; none in 6.-7.; 8. by interview only; 9. closed to new admissions.
notes: Prices stated as effective from 1 January 2026 (not aligned to skoleår). Fee includes notebooks/books/normal craft-subject material use. Paid via 12 monthly instalments, 1 Aug-1 Jul. SFO covers 0.-3. klasse, billed 11 months (12 with optional summer SFO). One-time 250 kr waitlist fee. Withdrawal requires 3 months' written notice (1 month for SFO-only).

name: European School Copenhagen - Primary and Secondary
siblingDiscount: Reduced/free SFO fees possible for lower-income families and siblings, but this is a Copenhagen Municipality policy (kk.dk), not a school-set discount
profile: Public, tuition-free international school in Copenhagen delivering the European Schools curriculum (European Baccalaureate) in Danish, English, and French language sections, from P0 through Secondary 7.
curriculum: European Schools curriculum (Accredited European School; European Baccalaureate) — not IB
waitlist: Rolling admissions for existing classes (applications 1 Sep-1 May, reviewed only in Dec & May if space exists); separate windows for new Nursery/Secondary 1 classes (late Nov-mid Jan, decisions in April) and Secondary 5 (mid-Jan-1 Mar via optagelse.dk, decisions in May). Space is limited/competitive; unsuccessful applicants can reapply annually.
notes: esc.aula.dk (given website) is the login-walled Aula intranet, not a public marketing site — actual public site is escph.dk, used for this research. Tuition, books and materials are free ('public international school'). After School Care fee is explicitly NOT published on the school's own site as a fixed number; the school directs families to Copenhagen Municipality's own childcare price page (kk.dk), and states fees vary by residency and income. Upper-secondary students must provide their own computer and budget for excursions.

name: Park Allé Privatskole
profile: Independent school (friskole) in Brøndbyvester — the municipality's only free primary school. Older sources (~2017-18) describe it as built on 'Asian values' with Chinese-language/culture teaching; the current (2026) site instead foregrounds a 'kampkunst' (martial arts) concept built on five dojo-kun principles (honesty, diligence, respect, self-control, striving for good character), combined with global-citizenship education and some Grundtvig-inspired language about joy in learning. Ambassador school for Save the Children (Red Barnet).
waitlist: Admission via waitlist; priority order is gender balance, then siblings of currently enrolled students, then staff children, then waitlist date. Waitlist registration fee 460.50 kr (one-time, via a 'Tilmelding til venteliste' purchase on the school's Shopify-based site). Site content indicated open seats in 7th and 8th grade.
notes: No skolepenge/priser/betaling page exists anywhere in the site's full page sitemap (33 pages checked) — monthly fee, SFO fee, sibling fee-discount and enrollment/indskud figures were not found published online; families would need to contact the school directly for current pricing. Not closed — site is active and current (references autumn 2026 dates and a June 2027 open house).

name: Københavns Skole & Idrætsakademi
feeYear: 2026/27 (implied; page itself only says 'indeværende skoleår'/current school year without an explicit label, but elsewhere references skoleåret 2026/2027)
profile: Private school in Copenhagen combining standard grundskole academics with a sports-academy track (football, tennis, ice hockey), emphasising talent development for 'body and mind'.
waitlist: Applicants must be on the school's waitlist, then pass a sport-specific trial-training/testing period plus an admission interview (and a motor-skills test for younger 'indskoling' applicants) before acceptance.
notes: 12 monthly payments Aug-Jul, continuing even for students leaving after 9th grade. Deposit of 3 months' tuition (6,450 kr) due on acceptance, refunded only if the student completes through 9th grade; forfeited otherwise. One-time non-refundable 750 kr fee covers application administration, admission interview and sports assessment testing. Mandatory 'fruit fee' of 29 kr/month is added automatically (11 months, not charged in July) and cannot be opted out of. Late fees apply: 100 kr per payment reminder, +50 kr/instalment if not paid via PBS. No SFO/after-school care was found mentioned anywhere on the site.

name: Den Grønne Friskole
siblingDiscount: 750 kr/month reduction per additional child from same household
profile: A friskole (independent primary school) in Copenhagen with a strong sustainability/green-transition profile, teaching in mixed-age (aldersblandet) groups of 15-20 pupils; does not identify with a named pedagogical tradition such as Grundtvig-Kold or Montessori.
waitlist: Applications via ventelisten.net; 300 kr non-refundable admin/Skolekreds membership fee; mandatory info meeting required to proceed; siblings of enrolled pupils prioritized; school picks 'best match' for a vacancy rather than following strict waitlist order.
notes: SFO ('Legeriet') 1,076 kr/month covers grades 0.-5.; separate 'Klub' for grades 6.-9. costs 413 kr/month (not entered as sfoMonthlyDKK since it's a different tier). Fees effective from 1 Aug 2026, billed over 12 months via PBS. Late fees: 50 kr at 14 days overdue, 100 kr at 30 days; 75 kr admin fee if not paid via PBS. Limited income-based fee subsidies available (apply by 1 Sept). Languages/curriculum not explicitly stated on site; assumed standard Danish as no bilingual/international program is mentioned.

name: Hvidovre Privatskole
profile: A mainstream two-track (two classes per grade since 2021/22) private school in Hvidovre using outcome/objective-driven teaching ('læringsmålstyret undervisning'); offers German (not French) as a foreign-language subject; ~448 pupils.
waitlist: Continuous/rolling waitlist; 500 kr non-refundable waitlist fee determines seniority by payment date; priority given to siblings of current pupils and gender balance in classes; accepted pupils undergo a trial week (tested in Danish and math) before final admission decision.
notes: July is a fee-free month (11 of 12 months billed) for both tuition and SFO. SFO is for grades 0.-3. and mandatory for that age range per the SFO page. Separate refundable deposit (depositum) of 3,000 kr required, offset at final settlement when pupil leaves. A one-time Chromebook purchase is also required at enrollment (amount not stated). Late payment fee 100 kr at 10 and 20 days overdue; 50 kr surcharge for bank transfer instead of PBS. No sibling discount mentioned anywhere on site.

name: VerdensBørn Grundskole
siblingDiscount: 50% off tuition for the 2nd child
profile: A small independent grundskole in Copenhagen centered on each child's personal development ('dannelsesrejse'), with 'Identitet og Dannelse' (Identity and Formation) as a core subject alongside standard subjects like Danish, PE and music; emphasizes daily exercise/assembly, communal meals, and twice-yearly parent conferences.
waitlist: Applications accepted from the calendar year a child turns 3; earliest school start is age 6; managed via venteliste@vbgrundskole.dk.
notes: Domain 'verdensbørn.com' uses IDN/punycode (xn--verdensbrn-7cb.com) but resolved fine directly. The 2,400 kr/month fee is stated as ALL-INCLUSIVE (tuition + lunch + SFO combined), not broken down by grade or billed as a separate SFO fee — hence sfoMonthlyDKK is null (it's bundled, not because it's unknown). The 300 kr fee is charged when applying (an administrative/application fee tied to the waitlist), which may function like an enrollment fee. Separately, a 'Skolekreds' (school circle/alumni-parent association) membership costs 50 kr/year — unrelated to tuition. Number of monthly installments per year and the applicable fee year were not stated on the site.

name: Den Frie Fakkel
siblingDiscount: 2nd child 2,520 kr/month; 3rd child 2,320 kr/month (vs. 2,920 kr for 1st child)
feeYear: prices as of 1 January 2026 (re-indexed annually each 1 Jan)
profile: A newly established/growing friskole in Copenhagen (København S) built around six pillars: nurturing individual talents/passions, learning through play and hands-on experience, daily meditation practice, valuing process over results, collaboration, and creative thinking.
gradesOffered: 0-2 currently, expanding year by year (school appears newly founded, admitting one new cohort per year; interest list open for 0. klasse intakes through 2033)
waitlist: Two-stage process: an 'interesseliste' (interest list) fee of 500 kr/child covers listing for future 0. klasse cohorts (2028-2033 mentioned); admission interviews for currently open spots across several grades are held and filled on an ongoing/rolling basis.
notes: Monthly fee INCLUDES mandatory after-school care ('fritidsordning'), so sfoMonthlyDKK is null (bundled, not separate). Paid via PBS on the 1st of the month, 12 payments (school year Aug 1-Jul 31). Beyond the interest-list fee, upon actual acceptance families must pay: 2 months' tuition upfront, a non-refundable deposit of 3,000 kr (used here as enrollmentFeeDKK), and a separate REFUNDABLE deposit of 10,000 kr (returned when the child leaves the school). School day runs 8:45-14:00 for grades 0-2 and 8:45-15:00 for other classes; morning care from 7:30, afternoon care 14:00-17:00 (Fri to 16:30). Grade range is uncertain/in flux since the school seems to be in a multi-year opening/ramp-up phase — verify current grades directly with the school.

name: Unity Skolen
siblingDiscount: 2nd child and subsequent children pay 700 kr/month (100 kr less than the 1st-child rate of 800 kr)
profile: A private school in Glostrup describing a child-centered approach with low student-teacher ratios, character development, and tolerance across 'faith, gender, sexuality and race'; site text also references religion as a source of 'inner peace and strength', suggesting some values/faith dimension, but this is not clearly specified.
waitlist: Online waitlist registration with payment ('Venteliste Unity Skolen' / 'Tilmeld Ventelisten'); a mandatory info meeting ('Infomøde') is offered for interested families.
notes: CAUTION: several subpages (e.g. 'Om Skolen', 'Værdigrundlag') contain what reads like generic/unfinished template marketing copy — including references to pupils 'aged 13-19' and a 'Best School for Science Award 2017' — which do not fit a Danish 0.-9. klasse grundskole and suggest the site may have unreplaced placeholder content on some pages. The fee figures on the dedicated /priser/ page, by contrast, are concrete, in DKK, and phrased in ordinary Danish ('pr. måned i 12 måneder'), so they are more trustworthy than the profile/pedagogy text. Grades offered and religious/pedagogical affiliation could not be reliably confirmed; recommend contacting the school directly or visiting in person to verify profile before relying on it. Fee year not stated (no indication prices are 2026/27-specific).

name: Byens Steinerskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child 2,125 kr/month (Bh.kl.-4.kl.) or 2,551 kr (5.-9.kl.); 3rd child 1,487 kr/month (Bh.kl.-4.kl.) or 1,885 kr (5.-9.kl.) — roughly 23% less for 2nd child, 46% less for 3rd child, vs. 1st-child rate
profile: A Waldorf/Steiner school in Copenhagen following anthroposophical pedagogy: a single class teacher binds subjects into a holistic whole, curriculum is staged to child development (imaginative/play-based in early years, increasingly analytical/abstract later), and learning is grounded in embodied, hands-on experience ('you must grasp before you can comprehend').
waitlist: Waitlist registration fee 450 kr (via NemID); separate waitlist also exists for the affiliated 'Lærkelunden' kindergarten (børnehave); families are asked at each year-end whether they wish to remain on the list.
notes: Full monthly fee table (1st/2nd/3rd child): Bh.kl.-4.kl.: 2,762 / 2,125 / 1,487 kr; 5.-9.kl.: 3,218 / 2,551 / 1,885 kr — 1st-grade pupils fall in the lower (Bh.kl.-4.kl.) tier, so monthlyFeeDKK uses 2,762. SFO ('Fritidshjem', Bh.kl.-4.kl.) 'eftermiddagspasning' (afternoon care to 16:30/16:00 Fri) is 1,159/869/579 kr for 1st/2nd/3rd child; optional 'morgenpasning' (morning care 7:30-8:30, min. 5 signups) is an extra 450/338/225 kr; ad-hoc single-day morning care costs a flat 100 kr. Optional solo music instruction is 400 kr/month/child. Enrollment fee ('indmeldelsesgebyr') in the grundskole is 5,000 kr per pupil but capped at 5,000 kr TOTAL per family if multiple siblings enroll simultaneously; non-refundable. A separate 'forudbetalte skolepenge' (prepaid tuition) of 12,000 kr per pupil is due before school start and covers the school's last 3 months of tuition. Optional 'Støtteforening' (support association) membership costs 250 kr/year. Late fee: 1%/month interest plus 100 kr reminder fee; 150 kr admin fee if not paid via PBS. Prices rise ~3% annually each 1 Aug (this table effective 1 Aug 2026, last updated 5 May 2026). English and German are introduced as foreign-language subjects from 1st grade (via songs/games), not as parallel instruction languages — primary instruction remains Danish, hence languages recorded as ["da"] only.

name: Farum Lilleskole
siblingDiscount: School fee: 2nd child -250 kr/month, 3rd child -250 kr/month, 4th child and beyond free (same registered address). SFO: -200 kr/month from 2nd child onward (same address).
profile: Farum Lilleskole is an independent 'lilleskole' (progressive alternative primary/lower-secondary school) in Furesø, part of the Danish lilleskole movement founded on close relationships, outdoor education (udeskole), musical-creative learning, and shared community between children, staff and parents.
curriculum: Danish (own pedagogical/reform profile; students sit standard Folkeskole leaving exams after 9th grade)
waitlist: Operates an application/waiting-list system; admission proceeds via written application plus an informal 'expectation-alignment' conversation (not a formal interview) between school and family; class composition also weighs siblings, gender balance, wellbeing/dynamics, and application timing.
notes: Fees billed monthly in advance, 12 months/year ('Der afregnes for alle årets 12 måneder'). Besides the 3,000 kr (max 5,000 kr per family) enrollment fee, there is also a separate one-time non-refundable registration fee of 500 kr/child, plus a security deposit equal to 3 months of school fees (refunded on withdrawal). SFO fee (1,175 kr/month) includes afternoon meals. 'Klub Åbne Døre' after-school club: 200 kr/month for grades 5-6, 100 kr/month for grades 7-9 (no sibling discount on Klub). An annual 'camp school' (lejrskole) surcharge is also assessed, amount unspecified. Fee is flat/uniform across all grades.

name: Viking International School
siblingDiscount: 350 DKK/month discount per additional sibling per the current official 2026-27 fee sheet. (Note: other site text elsewhere describes an older tiered scheme — 2nd sibling -350/month, 3rd sibling -33%, 4th+ free — but the dated 2026-27 fee PDF states a flat 350 DKK/month per additional sibling.)
profile: Viking International School (VIS) is an international primary school in Ballerup combining the British National Curriculum with the Danish National Curriculum (Fælles Mål) and the International Primary Curriculum (IPC); mainly English-medium, with Danish (and some subjects like Music, Art, PE in Danish) and French also taught.
curriculum: British National Curriculum + Danish Fælles Mål + International Primary Curriculum (IPC)
gradesOffered: Not explicitly published; indirect references (IC1-IC5 early years classes, IPC1-IPC4+ primary classes) suggest roughly Danish 0.-6. klasse equivalent, but the exact top grade could not be confirmed from the site
waitlist: Admission via application form and assessment/interview (OpenApply portal). School states spaces are sometimes available and will tell applicants whether a waiting list exists for a specific grade.
notes: General Tuition 3,527 DKK/month, payable 11 months (Aug-June); flat rate, not grade-tiered. A separate 'Inclusion Tuition' of 15,855 DKK/month applies to pupils requiring dedicated support services. Admission fees: 200 DKK nonrefundable application fee + 2,000 DKK nonrefundable admission fee (=2,200 DKK counted as enrollmentFeeDKK) + 7,700 DKK refundable deposit (total upfront ~9,900 DKK, of which 7,700 is returned later). SFO/'Mellemtrinsklub' has a 'Light' option at 600 DKK/month vs full option at 1,750 DKK/month (used here as sfoMonthlyDKK). 'Klub' for older students is billed via Ballerup Kommune based on home municipality, not by VIS directly. Various administrative fees also apply (e.g., late pickup 250 DKK, transcripts 150 DKK).

name: International Montessori School Copenhagen
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: -300 DKK/month; 3rd child: -500 DKK/month; 4th child: -1,200 DKK/month. Also 3% discount for full-year prepayment and 2% for half-year prepayment.
profile: A Montessori school in Ballerup (Copenhagen area) following Maria Montessori's pedagogy, with English as the main language of instruction and Danish taught in separate groups; serves preschool (age 2.5-5) through elementary (age 5.5-12+), with a middle school (ages 12.5-15) planned to open in 2027.
gradesOffered: Preschool (2.5-5) through Elementary (5.5-12+), roughly equivalent to Danish 0.-6. klasse; Middle school (12.5-15) planned for 2027
waitlist: Site states 'still availability' as of the check date; admission via pre-enrollment form, application, questionnaire, interview, and typically a trial week. No explicit waiting list mentioned.
notes: Monthly fee is 3,000 DKK for children with a Danish CPR number registered by September 5th; 4,800 DKK/month applies to children without CPR or registered after September 5th. Site labels this fee schedule 'FEES 2025/2026' — no separately dated 2026/2027 update was found as of the September 2026 check, so it may be due for a refresh. Enrollment fee 3,500 DKK is non-refundable; a separate refundable security deposit equal to 2 months of school fees is also required (refunded 3 months after a withdrawal notice). Before-school care (before 8:00) costs an extra 500 DKK/month on top of the 1,500 DKK/month afternoon care (used as sfoMonthlyDKK); drop-in afternoon care is 120 DKK/hour. Staff hold AMI/AMS Montessori certifications; no IB or other formal accreditation mentioned. All amounts already in DKK, no currency conversion needed.
